arguments.sql_query:
WITH depression_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (440383, 4152280) -- Depressive disorder; Major depressive disorder
), first_depression AS (
    SELECT
        co.person_id,
        MIN(CAST(co.condition_start_date AS date)) AS first_dx_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN depression_concepts dc
      ON co.condition_concept_id = dc.concept_id
    GROUP BY co.person_id
)
SELECT
    YEAR(first_dx_date) AS diagnosis_year,
    MONTH(first_dx_date) AS diagnosis_month,
    COUNT(*) AS new_depression_diagnoses
FROM first_depression
WHERE first_dx_date >= '2019-01-01'
  AND first_dx_date < '2022-01-01'
GROUP BY YEAR(first_dx_date), MONTH(first_dx_date)
ORDER BY diagnosis_year, diagnosis_month;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT
    YEAR(fd.first_dx_date) AS diagnosis_year,
    MONTH(fd.first_dx_date) AS diagnosis_month,
    COUNT(*) AS new_depression_diagnoses
FROM (
    SELECT
        co.person_id,
        MIN(CAST(co.condition_start_date AS date)) AS first_dx_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
        FROM omop.concept_ancestor
        WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (440383, 4152280)
    ) dc
      ON co.condition_concept_id = dc.concept_id
    GROUP BY co.person_id
) fd
WHERE fd.first_dx_date >= '2019-01-01'
  AND fd.first_dx_date < '2022-01-01'
GROUP BY YEAR(fd.first_dx_date), MONTH(fd.first_dx_date)
ORDER BY diagnosis_year, diagnosis_month;

content.text:
Using first-ever depression diagnosis per patient (OMOP descendants of **Depressive disorder** and **Major depressive disorder**), monthly new diagnoses show a **gradual decline from 2019 to 2021**.

| Year | Total new diagnoses | Monthly average |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2019 | 15,039 | 1,253 |
| 2020 | 14,320 | 1,193 |
| 2021 | 13,737 | 1,145 |

**Observed trends**
- **Overall downward trend:** 2021 totals were ~8.7% lower than 2019.
- **2019 was consistently highest**, with most months around 1,200–1,350 new diagnoses; peak was **Mar 2019: 1,359**.
- **2020 dipped early** but recovered mid/late year; highest was **Oct 2020: 1,272**.
- **2021 remained lower overall**, with the lowest month in the period at **Aug 2021: 1,062**.
- No clear sustained monthly surge is evident across 2020–2021; instead, counts fluctuate month-to-month around a declining baseline.
